_README: Thresholds for tomtom_data_integration.py, kept as data so that each one
can carry the evidence it came from. Same convention as match_rules.json:
a null value means 'not yet decided' and the code refuses to run on it.

note: Radius within which a TomTom sample point may be attributed to an ADB piece,
and the Frechet ceiling for accepting a part.
Matched parts at 20 m: Frechet p50 4.1 m, p90 10.9, p99 18.5; mean offset p50 2.8 m, p99 16.0.
Opening it gains little and what it gains is worse: 25 m +224 TomTom
segments (+75 km), 30 m +335, 40 m +407. Street-name agreement between
TomTom streetName and ADB names_primary is 24.6% over all matches (names
are formatted differently, so only the relative value means anything) but
17.4% / 11.4% / 10.1% over the segments each step adds.
Unmatched motorway (frc 0) TomTom lies a median 693 m from any ADB line:
roads ADB does not carry, not a tolerance problem.

bearing_tolerance_deg.by: reused from match_rules.json bearing_tolerance_deg (measured there: nearest-way bearing difference median 0.6, p95 7.2 degrees)

bearing_window_m.by: design. A line shorter than the window is measured end to end.

sample_step_m.by: design: every TomTom vertex plus points at min(step, length / min_samples_per_tomtom), so a 3 m segment still gets 10 samples

min_tomtom_frac.evidence: Share is bimodal: 2,218 TomTom segments at 0, 16,102 at 1, 623 in between spread thinly (106 in 0.6-0.8). 0.8 sits in that trough.
min_tomtom_frac.note: Share of a TomTom segment's length that must lie beside SOME ADB piece. Keeps a road that ADB does not carry from being picked up where it merely passes close.

min_part_frac.by: design for the share; measurement for the length condition
note: A TomTom segment running through a junction is split into one part per
uninterrupted segment. A part below this share of the TomTom length AND no
longer than max_distance_m is its overhang past the junction and is not a
match. The share keeps short TomTom segments from being penalised; the
length condition keeps a real 300 m stretch of a 2 km TomTom segment.
Maharashtra 2026-09-24: 31% of matched TomTom segments had such an overhang dropped.

frechet_segmentize_m.by: design: discrete Frechet over vertices densified to this spacing errs by at most half of it

same_point_tolerance_m.by: observation: ADB and OSM coordinates agree to about the 5th decimal (~1.1 m)
same_point_tolerance_m.note: Two cut positions this close on one ADB line are the same junction seen through two sources, and a cut this close to a line end is that end. Not a sliver policy: genuine short pieces are kept.

adb_vertex_snap_m.by: match_rules.json vertex_cell_decimals=6 with a 3x3 neighbourhood (~0.11 m each way), expressed as a distance

t_junction_tolerance_m.by: design: an ADB line end within this distance of another ADB line's interior is a T junction

heavy_overlap_frac.by: design: two same-direction TomTom segments whose ADB ranges overlap by at least half of the shorter one compete; the one nearer the ADB line wins
